command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
Write-Host "===== IMMUTABLE RELEASES ====="
$immutableOutput=& gh api repos/tngkrwlsmd/flyExplorer/immutable-releases 2>&1
$immutableCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host ("IMMUTABLE_RELEASES_QUERY_EXIT="+$immutableCode)
$immutableOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ("IMMUTABLE_RELEASES_QUERY="+$_) }
Write-Host "===== REPOSITORY ====="
& gh api repos/tngkrwlsmd/flyExplorer --jq '{visibility,private,default_branch,archived,disabled}'
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "repository metadata query failed"}
Write-Host "===== EXISTING RELEASES ====="
$releaseOutput=& gh api repos/tngkrwlsmd/flyExplorer/releases 2>&1
$releaseCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host ("RELEASE_QUERY_EXIT="+$releaseCode)
$releaseOutput | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ("RELEASE_QUERY="+$_) }
